projection._note: how stats no book prices get their mean: 'salary' (refactor.volume: salary + TD odds) or 'environment' (refactor.usage: team volume from the QB line / game environment, minus the priced players, split by depth-rank priors); IVAN_UNPRICED_VOLUME overrides

calibration._note: map the field-sampling projection onto actual showdown ownership per slot and position (models/ownership_calibration.json from scripts/nfl/build_ownership_calibration.py); DST and K on projected points

ownership._model_note: learned: ownership_model.pkl (sampler projection + points/salary/ranks/position, fitted on scraped fields; scripts/nfl/build_ownership_model.py); sampler_calibrated: the sampler with the per-position calibration lines; sampler: raw exposures

ownership_calibration._note: rake the field sampler's lineup weights so player exposures match projected ownership (sample_field.rake_weights_to_ownership)

field._dupe_note: product: copies = N x k x prod(own)^beta fitted on real fields (models/dupe_model_v2.json, scripts/nfl/build_dupe_model.py build)
